The System Management Firmware Product Manager owns the customer-facing management capabilities delivered through XCC and UEFI, together with the product definition and governance of system-wide firmware packages across the server portfolio. The role sets capability scope and priorities, determines base and premium functionality, and makes enhancement, deferral and retirement decisions in partnership with architecture and engineering on feasibility and implementation.

Scope includes remote monitoring and control, inventory and health, diagnostics, configuration, power and thermal management, security and access control, management APIs, and integration with the wider XClarity ecosystem. It also covers coordinated firmware discovery, update, rollback and lifecycle management across XCC, UEFI and supported devices. Own product decisions on the inclusion and timing of third-party device firmware updates within Lenovo system firmware packages. Apply quality or security requirements established by the accountable teams, and evaluate other updates based on customer value, portfolio benefit, compatibility and lifecycle risk.

The role complements server product managers by owning the horizontal firmware capability roadmap and governance across the portfolio, while individual server product managers retain accountability for the definition, launch and business performance of their server products. The Product Manager translates customer, market, platform and engineering needs into a coherent roadmap, aligns stakeholders, and drives predictable execution across new and sustaining firmware releases and server platforms. Applying server-platform management expertise, the role improves firmware quality, customer experience and business value across the general-purpose server portfolio.

Responsibilities:

•
Own the Product Strategy and Definition for System Management Firmware

• Define and own the product vision, roadmap, requirements, feature scope, priorities, positioning, and customer value for Lenovo XClarity Controller (XCC), UEFI, and system management firmware capabilities.

• Make and document product decisions regarding feature inclusion, prioritization, enhancement, deferral, and retirement while balancing customer needs, business objectives, technical feasibility, lifecycle impacts, and risk.

• Partner with architecture and engineering teams to ensure firmware capabilities align with platform strategy and customer requirements.

•
Lead Firmware Lifecycle Management and Portfolio Governance

• Own the end-to-end lifecycle of firmware management capabilities, including roadmap planning, release management, launch readiness, sustaining engineering, and retirement.

• Define release scope, readiness criteria, and coordinated execution across quality, security, documentation, manufacturing, support, sales enablement, and field organizations.

• Govern system-wide firmware packages, including firmware discovery, updates, rollback, compatibility, and lifecycle management across XCC, UEFI, and supported hardware devices.

•
Drive Cross-Functional Execution and Organizational Alignment

• Lead coordination across product management, architecture, firmware development, hardware engineering, validation, manufacturing, supply chain, security, support, sales, and marketing teams.

• Manage dependencies, risks, escalations, and competing priorities to ensure predictable execution and successful delivery of firmware releases.

• Establish decision-making frameworks and accountability models that clearly distinguish product ownership from technical implementation responsibilities.

•
Enhance Product Competitiveness and Customer Value

• Ensure firmware capabilities meet competitive expectations for manageability, security, resiliency, serviceability, performance, power efficiency, and overall customer experience.

• Monitor customer feedback, adoption metrics, field quality data, and market trends to identify opportunities for innovation, simplification, and differentiation.

• Own decisions regarding third-party device firmware inclusion and update timing within Lenovo system firmware packages, considering customer value, quality, security, compatibility, and lifecycle impacts.

•
Leverage Data, Analytics, and Market Insights

• Establish, maintain, and evaluate key performance indicators (KPIs) related to firmware adoption, update success rates, customer experience, support outcomes, release readiness, and roadmap execution.

• Maintain high-quality product documentation, requirements, decision records, risk assessments, and supporting materials to ensure traceability and operational excellence.

• Engage with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders to translate market insights into measurable firmware capability improvements and business outcomes.

•
Serve as a Subject Matter Expert and Industry Advocate

• Act as a recognized authority on server management firmware, platform management technologies, and industry trends.

• Stay current on emerging technologies, standards, and partner roadmaps across CPU, BMC, NIC, storage, RAID, GPU, PCIe, CXL, memory, and related platform technologies.

• Share expertise, mentor stakeholders, and drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance product quality, operational efficiency, and customer satisfaction.

Basic Qualifications:

• 8+ years of experience in server, infrastructure, firmware, platform, software, hardware, or related product management and technical leadership roles

• Proven track record of defining, delivering, launching, or managing complex technology products, platform capabilities, firmware solutions, or infrastructure offerings throughout the product lifecycle.

• Strong understanding of server platform architecture and firmware technologies, including BIOS, UEFI, BMC, XCC, platform management firmware, and device firmware.

• Experience leading cross-functional initiatives across engineering, architecture, validation, manufacturing, supply chain, quality, security, support, sales, marketing, and supplier organizations within a global business environment.

• Demonstrated ability to evaluate risks, manage ambiguity, balance competing priorities, influence stakeholders, and drive product decisions to successful outcomes.

This role is part of Lenovo’s International Sales Organization (ISO), focused on Infrastructure Solutions (ISG), reporting to the ISO ISG Business Operations Leader. They are accountable for driving the operating rigor and execution discipline for a sales team selling to our Cloud Services Provider (CSP) customers across international markets, including revenue, pipeline, and growth objectives. This role serves as a strategic partner to the VP of CSP Sales, ensuring the business operates with a consistent cadence, clear performance visibility, and strong alignment from strategy through frontline execution. This is a highly visible role requiring strong business acumen, executive presence, and the ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights that drive outcomes. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of running an effective sales cadence and management system, shaping operating models, and influencing senior stakeholders in a matrixed environment.

This position is remote, part of a global team, and aligned to an Executive residing in PST business hours. Flexibility regarding working schedule will be required.

Key Responsibilities

• Own the ISO ISG CSP sales operating cadence, ensuring consistent execution and alignment from leadership to frontline

• Drive performance against targets, strengthening forecast accuracy, pipeline health, and accountability

• Shape business decisions through insights, identifying risks, root causes, and opportunities to accelerate growth

• Optimize sales coverage, and lead the quota planning process, aligning resources to highest-impact growth areas

• Establish and enforce pipeline management and quality standards, improving conversion, deal velocity, and overall funnel health

• Partner cross-functionally to align on priorities and execute key initiatives

• Drive strategic initiatives and continuous improvement efforts, including tools, reporting, and operating model evolution

Basic Qualifications

• 8+ years of Sales Operations or related experience, with increasing scope and leadership responsibility

• Experience with CRM and analytics tools (Dynamics and Power BI preferred)

• Bachelor’s degree in business, technical or related field

Preferred Qualifications

• Strong business and financial acumen, with the ability to connect operational drivers to revenue outcomes

• Experience designing and scaling sales operating cadences, processes, and coverage models

• Proven ability to operate at both strategic and execution levels in a matrixed organization

• Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with ability to translate data into clear actions

• Executive-level communication and stakeholder management skills

Advisory Engineer, Development

About Our Team

Lenovo’s Cloud Service Provider (CSP) Group develops server and rack infrastructure for leading public cloud customers worldwide. We are a fast-paced, customer-focused organization that adapts to changing market demands and customer needs.

Our end-to-end capabilities span design, manufacturing, testing, service, and worldwide deployment, allowing us to deliver solutions for even the most unique datacenter computing requirements.

The CSP organization works directly with hyperscale and cloud customers, requiring engineers who can translate customer requirements into technical solutions while driving cross-functional execution across development, validation, manufacturing, quality, and compliance organizations.

We are seeking an experienced Advisory Engineer, Development – Systems Engineer to help develop and validate cloud datacenter infrastructure. This role serves as a key technical interface between customers, engineering teams, and technology partners to translate requirements into server and rack solutions, resolve technical issues, improve product quality, and drive end-to-end program execution.

What You’ll Do

• Apply knowledge of Intel x86, AMD, NVIDIA, FPGA, and ARM-based technology roadmaps to help shape future datacenter architectures for leading public cloud customers.

• Serve as a primary technical interface for customers, translating customer requirements into engineering solutions and providing technical guidance throughout product development and integration activities.

• Review customer requirements to drive fully integrated L11 rack solutions, including server/node, rack, and scale-level test plans, cable mappings, rack configurations, serviceability, and manageability.

• Support rack-level architecture, bill of materials (BOM) development, and power analysis at the subsystem, node, rack, and lab levels.

• Develop and validate server and rack infrastructure for cloud datacenters, including compute, storage, and networking solutions.

• Collaborate closely with BIOS, BMC, validation, quality, compliance, systems, manufacturing, customer engineering teams, vendor field application engineers (FAEs), and technology partners to communicate and resolve technical issues.

• Conduct system log reviews with validation and development teams, and review test plans with systems engineering, development, manufacturing, and customer teams.

• Perform failure analysis, identify root causes, drive corrective actions, and take ownership of issues through resolution while maintaining accountability to customers and internal stakeholders.

• Evaluate solutions from an end-to-end systems perspective, ensuring design, validation, quality, serviceability, manageability, and customer requirements are fully aligned.

• Engage suppliers and technology partners providing storage devices, network controllers, network interface cards (NICs), accelerators, and emerging hardware technologies.

• Partner with validation, systems, manufacturing, and quality engineering teams to resolve issues found during testing, coordinating between component vendors, technology partners, and customers.

• Identify opportunities to automate testing and work with validation and scripting teams to improve engineering and testing efficiency.

• Lead and coordinate cross-functional project teams to execute customer deliverables, ensuring technical alignment, schedule adherence, risk mitigation, and issue escalation when required.

• Provide constructive technical feedback to Technical Program Managers (TPMs) to support development and test schedules.

• Document best practices and lessons learned to improve product quality, cross-team collaboration, customer satisfaction, and testing efficiency.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any federal, state, or local protected class.

Cluster Solution Architect

About Our Team

Lenovo's Cloud Service Provider (CSP) team designs AI infrastructure solutions for hyperscalers, NeoCloud providers, and other data center customers. We bring together GPU platforms, high-performance networking, cluster software, and data center infrastructure to support large-scale AI training and inference.

As a Cluster Solutions Architect, you'll translate customer requirements into integrated, scalable solutions and compelling technical proposals. You'll collaborate with customers, sales teams, technology partners, and engineering teams to shape architectures that balance performance, efficiency, operational requirements, and deployment feasibility.

Ideal candidates will bring experience designing, architecting, and supporting large-scale AI infrastructure solutions in customer-facing environments, including GPU cluster deployments, AI inference platforms, and integrated hardware and software solutions for enterprise, cloud, hyperscale, or data center customers.

What You'll Do

• Design and optimize end-to-end AI inference and AI training solutions, with a primary emphasis on AI inference architecture, software stack integration, and production deployment of large-scale GPU cluster environments using NVIDIA software and platform technologies, including NVIDIA AI Enterprise, Dynamo, NIM, NVIDIA Infrastructure Controller (NICo), Mission Control, LPx, and emerging inference acceleration capabilities.

• Evaluate architecture tradeoffs to improve token latency, throughput, GPU utilization, and overall AI service efficiency.

• Translate customer workload, capacity, networking, power, and cooling requirements into integrated cluster architectures and technical recommendations.

• Design integrated AI cluster solutions that combine GPU compute platforms, high-performance networking, software stack components, storage, and supporting data center infrastructure into scalable customer-ready architectures.

• Provide technical leadership and architecture guidance throughout the customer solution lifecycle, including requirements gathering, solution design, technical reviews, proposal development, and customer presentations.

• Develop and deliver technical presentations, proofs of concept (POCs), demonstrations, and customer-facing solution proposals that clearly articulate architecture decisions, business value, technical differentiation, and deployment considerations.

• Support customer engagements by evaluating technical requirements and recommending scalable AI cluster architectures that balance performance, operational efficiency, deployment feasibility, and cost considerations.

• Prepare and contribute to requests for proposal (RFPs) and requests for quotation (RFQs), including technical compliance responses, solution documentation, bills of materials (BOMs), and customer-facing architecture content.

• Partner with engineering, deployment, hardware, networking, and supply chain teams to validate proposed solutions and confirm technical feasibility.

• Mentor junior RFP contributors and sales engineers, providing guidance on customer requirements, solution design, and common architecture tradeoffs.

• Develop best practices, reusable templates, reference architectures, sizing guidelines, and technical response content to improve proposal quality and response speed.

• Stay current on GPU roadmaps, high-speed networking, liquid cooling, cluster management, AI software ecosystems, inference optimization technologies, and emerging data center technologies.

Basic Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related engineering field; candidates with other educational backgrounds will also be considered if they demonstrate sufficient relevant technical knowledge.

• 10+ years of experience in data center infrastructure, solution architecture, systems engineering, pre-sales engineering, or technical consulting.

• Experience with large-scale AI inference and AI training workloads, including large language model (LLM) infrastructure, model serving environments, capacity planning, performance optimization, and production deployment of AI solutions.

• Experience designing, supporting, or deploying customer-facing AI infrastructure solutions, GPU clusters, high-performance computing environments, or large-scale data center architectures.

• Strong understanding of AI software stacks, cluster management environments, and infrastructure integration, with the ability to translate customer business and technical requirements into deployable solutions.

• Experience working directly with customers, technical stakeholders, sales teams, or solution engineering organizations to develop and validate technical solution designs.

• Strong knowledge of high-performance networking for AI clusters, including InfiniBand, RDMA over Converged Ethernet (RoCE), network operating systems, and deployment and discovery protocols such as ZTP, DHCP, LLDP, and SNMP.

• Familiarity with data center networking, high-speed optical interconnects, transceiver and fiber form factors, and interoperability requirements.

• Knowledge of liquid cooling, coolant distribution units (CDUs), high-density rack design, power distribution units (PDUs), busway systems, and AI data center power and cooling constraints.

• Familiarity with Python or another scripting language, automation tools, and infrastructure as code to support solution validation and design.

• Willingness to travel up to 10% for customer meetings, technical workshops, partner engagements, and industry events.

• Commitment to continuously learning new GPU, networking, and data center technologies.

Preferred Qualifications

• Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related engineering field.

• 5+ years of experience preparing or contributing to RFP/RFQ responses, including technical compliance, solution documentation, BOM development, and customer-facing architecture content, ideally for NVIDIA HGX or DGX platforms.

• Working knowledge of cluster software and management environments, including Linux, Slurm, Kubernetes, Docker, NVIDIA Infrastructure Controller (NICo), NVIDIA Mission Control, ROCm, or related tools, with experience deploying and managing production AI inference environments preferred.

• Deep understanding of modern GPU server architectures, including NVIDIA and/or AMD accelerator-based systems.

• Experience supporting organizations that design, manufacture, integrate, or deploy enterprise AI infrastructure, GPU-based computing platforms, high-performance computing environments, or large-scale data center solutions.

• Familiarity with hyperscaler data center infrastructure and operating environments, with demonstrated experience supporting hyperscaler, NeoCloud, or other data center infrastructure customers.

• Demonstrated experience developing technical proposals, architecture documentation, statements of work, solution recommendations, or customer-facing technical deliverables for complex infrastructure projects.

• Strong written communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical requirements into clear, accurate customer-facing proposals and architecture documentation.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any federal, state, or local protected class.

Solutions & Services Specialist – Retail

Lenovo is seeking a highly skilled Solutions & Services Specialist to support our Retail vertical, driving the growth and adoption of Lenovo’s Solutions & Services Group (SSG) portfolio across retail customers.

This role will focus on understanding the evolving needs of retail organizations and connecting those needs to Lenovo’s broad portfolio of solutions and services. The Solutions & Services Specialist will work closely with account executives, customers, partners, and internal solution teams to identify opportunities, develop customer-focused solutions, and drive complex services opportunities from initial discovery through closure.

This role is a critical bridge between sales, customers, and Lenovo’s broader solutions and services organization. You will bring a deep understanding of the Retail industry and its business priorities, helping customers address challenges, modernize their operations, improve employee and customer experiences, and achieve strategic business outcomes through Lenovo solutions and services.

The ideal candidate combines strong Retail industry knowledge, consultative selling skills, and customer-facing experience, with the ability to navigate complex organizations and bring together the right Lenovo capabilities to address customer needs.

This role will provide dedicated support to customers within the Retail vertical across the Central and West Coast regions. While the position is fully remote, we are seeking candidates located within these geographies to ensure strong alignment with customer needs, time zones, and regional coverage. Candidates should be comfortable working remotely while partnering closely with customers, account teams, and cross-functional stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

• Serve as the Solutions & Services sales specialist for the Retail vertical, supporting the development and growth of SSG opportunities across Retail customers.

• Partner with account executives and sales teams to identify, develop, progress, and close solutions and services opportunities within Retail accounts.

• Conduct customer discovery sessions to understand business priorities, operational challenges, technology environments, and desired outcomes.

• Translate Retail customer needs into tailored, outcome-driven solutions leveraging Lenovo’s broad Solutions & Services portfolio.

• Develop and articulate compelling value propositions that connect Lenovo solutions and services to the strategic priorities and challenges facing Retail customers.

• Lead customer conversations, presentations, and solution discussions throughout the sales cycle, bringing in additional Lenovo specialists and subject matter experts as needed.

• Serve as a trusted advisor to customers and account teams by providing Retail industry expertise and guidance on relevant solutions and services.

• Support complex customer pursuits, including RFP/RFI responses, proposals, presentations, and solution development.

• Collaborate across Lenovo teams to bring together the appropriate capabilities, resources, and expertise required to support customer opportunities.

• Build strong relationships with key customer stakeholders and establish credibility as a strategic partner focused on business outcomes.

• Support pipeline development and identify opportunities to expand Lenovo’s Solutions & Services presence within existing and prospective Retail accounts.

• Provide feedback to internal teams based on customer conversations, market trends, competitive insights, and evolving Retail requirements.

• Stay current on Retail industry trends, customer priorities, emerging technologies, and market changes to help identify new opportunities for Lenovo.

What You’ll Be Supporting

Lenovo Solutions & Services for the Retail Vertical

• Customer and employee experience transformation

• Digital workplace and workforce solutions

• Device lifecycle and managed services

• Infrastructure and technology modernization

• Deployment, support, and lifecycle services

• As-a-Service and consumption-based solutions

• AI-enabled solutions and services

• Other SSG capabilities aligned to Retail customer business priorities

At Lenovo, we're not just about creating technology; we're about powering the brilliant ideas that drive global innovation. Our mission is clear: to develop technology that enables our customers to achieve their greatest potential. We're on the hunt for ambitious individuals who are ready to thrive in a dynamic, global company culture.

If you're an early-career Sales Engineer looking to make a mark in the tech industry, Lenovo’s North American Solutions Sales team offers you a golden opportunity. This role is your chance to shine by leveraging your budding sales skills and technical knowledge in a high-impact, highly visible position centered on driving digital transformation in the datacenter domain.

This role presents an exciting journey into the world of consultative sales, focusing on helping businesses harness the power of Lenovo’s and our partners' technology. It's about enabling companies to evolve through automated, orchestrated, and multi-cloud platforms. While this is a junior-level role, you'll be at the forefront of promoting Lenovo's Data Center solutions, including AI, Converged, Hyper-converged, and Software-Defined Data Center solutions.

The Solutions Sales engineering team collaborates closely with Lenovo’s enterprise account teams, focusing on a select list of accounts to usher in transformation with Lenovo’s comprehensive edge to core offerings. This environment fosters a collaborative spirit, offering you the unique opportunity to consult while you sell, learning and growing within the organization.

As a member of the Lenovo NA Solutions Sales Team, you'll join a diverse group of sales professionals with a wide range of skills across data center technologies and solutions. Your role will involve:

• Leveraging your knowledge in data center technologies for consultative sales.

• Engaging with enterprise and acquisition prospects across various industries.

• Understanding and articulating the market dynamics and benefits of advanced data center technologies, especially in areas like Converged, Hyper-converged, and Software Defined solutions.

• Developing and executing a business plan to meet and exceed your sales targets.

• Building and expanding customer relationships through a strategic sales planning approach.

In this role, you're expected to gain expertise in several key technology and sales areas, including:

• Compute Platforms, particularly Servers used in the data center and edge Storage solutions, Hyper Visors, and Software Defined Storage.

• Understanding of Hybrid Cloud Solutions, Converged Platforms, Containers, Microservices, and Cloud Workload Placement.

• Develop and expand skills in solution sizing and systems management

Basic Qualifications:

• A Bachelor's degree or equivalent.

• Entry-level experience or internships in sales, particularly in technology-focused roles.

• 2+ years of foundational knowledge of the IT marketplace and advanced data center technologies.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Demonstrate budding skills in consultative selling, technology sales, and communication.

• Be eager to learn about complex sales cycles and strategies to engage with SMB and/or Public Sector customers.

• Exposure to or interest in Converged, Hyperconverged, and Software Defined Solutions.

• Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.

• An interest in developing sales strategies and working with Channel partners and technology partners.

• A team player attitude, open to learning and adapting to new environments.

• Ability to travel into territory 20% of the time.

This role is an unparalleled opportunity to start your journey in tech sales, offering a pathway to develop your skills, engage with cutting-edge technologies, and contribute to Lenovo's mission. If you're passionate about technology and eager to grow in a global, forward-thinking company, we want to hear from you.

Lenovo is seeking a high-impact OEM Edge AI / IoT Business Development Manager to grow our North American Edge AI and IoT business. This is a hunter role at the intersection of direct business development, ISV partnership development, and channel-led sales. It focuses on acquiring new logos, winning OEM design wins, and driving programs that deliver acquisition sales revenue.

In this role you will go beyond traditional sales. You will co-develop solutions from Lenovo's existing Edge AI / IoT roadmap, shape the future product roadmap through use case and business case justification, and serve as a key commercial voice for Lenovo's edge portfolio across verticals. You will also build joint solutions with ISVs that turn Lenovo hardware into validated, deployable edge AI offerings. Because edge deployments sit where operational technology meets information technology, you will engage both OT stakeholders (plant, operations, engineering, and facilities leaders) and IT stakeholders (CIO, infrastructure, security, and network teams) to align requirements, secure buy-in, and close deals. From initial prospecting to executive-level close, you will drive revenue and long-term profit growth, helping customers become more productive, innovative, and transformative.

What You'll Do

• Own the growth strategy: Develop and execute a strategic plan aligned to Lenovo's hypergrowth objectives, targeting net new prospects, channel-led Edge AI / IoT opportunities, and design wins across North America.

• Hunt and develop new business: Lead prospecting, scoping, and development of net new accounts and OEM programs as the core function of this role, driving consistent revenue growth year over year.

• Engage across OT and IT: Navigate and align both OT and IT organizations within customer accounts. Translate business outcomes for OT leaders (uptime, safety, throughput, quality, and asset performance) and for IT leaders (security, manageability, network integration, lifecycle, and compliance). Facilitate joint OT/IT decision-making to accelerate deal cycles and deployment success.

• Build and scale ISV partnerships: Identify, recruit, and co-sell with ISVs in edge AI, computer vision, analytics, IoT platforms, industrial automation, device management, and vertical applications. Drive joint solution validation, reference architectures, and go-to-market plans that bring ISV software and Lenovo edge hardware to market together.

• Drive channel collaboration: Partner with NSPs, Tier 2 partners, system integrators, OT-focused integrators and automation partners, distributors, and IoT/mobility partners to scale the region. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver on customer commitments.

• Shape the product roadmap: Use customer use cases and business case justifications, including requirements from both OT and IT environments, to influence Lenovo's future Edge AI / IoT roadmap (POR), giving the BU the insight needed to prioritize new products, platforms, and solutions.

• Build trusted advisor relationships: Apply embedded design sales experience to position yourself as a strategic partner at the executive level, engaging business line leaders, OT and IT decision makers, and key stakeholders.

• Forecast with precision: Maintain accurate, timely forecasting of growth, run rate, and pipeline across North America.

• Promote Lenovo's full Edge AI / IoT portfolio: Champion Lenovo's edge devices, gateways, and accelerators, along with accessories and adjacent third-party solutions. These span connectivity, software, AI/ML frameworks, security, device management tools, and custom services, and you will promote them through outbound communications, RFPs, QBRs, and industry events.

• Represent Lenovo externally: Present at Lenovo Solution Days, lead executive business reviews, and position Lenovo OEM as a strategic edge AI and IoT solution provider at relevant tradeshows (both industrial/OT and enterprise/IT) and on-stage engagements, including joint ISV events.

• Analyze and solve: Apply data-driven decision making to identify the best solutions for customer challenges, lead negotiations, and drive deals to close.

• 8+ years of sales, business development, or sales/marketing experience with specific emphasis on edge computing, IoT, or embedded hardware (software and services experience also valued)

• Demonstrated track record of acquiring net new accounts and closing large, complex OEM deals

• Experience selling into or across both OT and IT organizations, with an understanding of how each influences technology purchasing decisions

• Experience with Tier 1 and Tier 2 channel partners, growth strategies, and building channel relationships

Preferred Qualifications

• Knowledge of monitoring and observability tools such as Icinga, Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, and NVIDIA DCGM.
